name: Architectural maquette
Αρχιτεκτονική μακέτα
description: Concrete, metal and soft studio light. A miniature world of connected worksites.
Σκυρόδεμα, μέταλλο και απαλός φωτισμός. Μια μικρογραφία συνδεδεμένων εργοταξίων.
prompt: Create a premium conceptual portfolio cover for Aigistos, a custom ERP that brings construction worksites into one shared management system. Square image, no text, no logos, no typography. ART DIRECTION: a beautifully photographed physical architectural maquette, sophisticated miniature world, not a toy or generic SaaS 3D icon. Three distinct Greek construction sites: a partially built concrete building with scaffolding, a low industrial building, and stacked materials beside a small crane. Thin embedded teal routes in the ground connect these sites to one central architectural planning table holding neatly arranged physical work-record sheets. The relationship 'several worksites, one shared system' must be obvious. Matte plaster, pale concrete, brushed metal details, muted deep teal, warm stone and restrained amber. Seamless deep desaturated teal studio ground, soft directional daylight from upper left, exquisite contact shadows, tactile realistic materials, elevated three-quarter camera. Compose the entire meaningful scene in the central 75% of the image and upper two-thirds; bottom quarter is quiet dark teal negative space for HTML title overlay. Full bleed background, elegant editorial architectural photography, no people, no dashboard screens, no floating cubes, no neon, no padlocks. This is an illustrative model, not documentary evidence of a real client worksite.

name: Crafted paper
Χάρτινη σύνθεση
description: Folded architecture, paper ribbons and tactile fibres. Warmer and more illustrative.
Διπλωμένη αρχιτεκτονική, χάρτινες κορδέλες και υφές. Πιο ζεστό και εικονογραφικό.
prompt: Create a premium conceptual portfolio cover for Aigistos, a custom ERP connecting multiple construction worksites to one shared management system. Square full bleed image, no text, no logos, no letters or numbers. ART DIRECTION: handcrafted layered cut-paper editorial illustration, refined sophisticated graphic design with real paper fibres, precise folded edges and gentle physical shadows. Not 3D plastic, not cartoon clipart. Three distinct construction sites, one scaffolded concrete building, one industrial shed and one small materials yard with crane, rendered as intricately cut and folded paper architecture. Narrow teal paper ribbons travel from all three sites into one central shared planning folio containing neatly aligned work-record sheets, communicating many sites coordinated in one place. Use rich deep teal background paper, muted jade, chalk white, warm sandstone and small amber accents. Strong graphic silhouette and generous negative space, elevated almost overhead composition. The buildings and folio occupy the upper two-thirds and central 75% so they remain readable when cropped; lower quarter stays quiet deep teal paper for a title placed later in HTML. Beautiful art-directed paper craftsmanship, museum exhibition illustration quality. No people, no UI screenshots, no graphs, no generic tech icons, no glowing edges. Clearly an imagined conceptual illustration, not a real worksite.

name: Editorial collage
Εκδοτικό κολάζ
description: Architectural photo fragments, teal duotones and bold crops. More graphic and direct.
Αρχιτεκτονικά φωτογραφικά αποσπάσματα, διτονίες και τολμηρά καδραρίσματα. Πιο γραφιστικό και άμεσο.
prompt: Create a sophisticated conceptual editorial collage portfolio cover for Aigistos, a custom worksite ERP connecting construction operations into one shared system. Square full bleed image with NO text, logos, lettering, numbers or watermarks. ART DIRECTION: bold contemporary photographic montage, premium architecture magazine art direction, analogue photographic cutouts with subtle grain, precise geometric composition and restrained screenprinted colour. Not a miniature, not 3D render, not paper illustration. Use three large contrasting photographic fragments of Greek construction work: concrete structural columns and scaffolding, a crane against pale sky, and neatly stacked worksite materials. Arrange them as carefully cropped overlapping rectangular photographic planes, united by one deep teal route line leading into a central sharply photographed open planning folder with several organized blank work records. Each photographic fragment is predominantly black and white with subtle warm stone midtones; selected planes receive a rich teal duotone treatment and one small amber tab. Background is a solid deeply desaturated teal field with delicate analogue print texture. Visual story is multiple real-world operations brought into order. Place the main photographic composition in the upper two-thirds and central 75% of the frame, reserve the lower quarter as calm dark teal negative space for later HTML title overlay. Dramatic scale contrasts, precise elegant cut edges, confident negative space, crisp architectural detail. No people, no fake software interfaces, no robots, no brains, no charts. An invented conceptual artwork, not purported documentary photographs of the actual client.
